job.mca_vie.desc.farmer: Harvests ripe crops in their zone and replants with the seeds they carry.
job.mca_vie.desc.lumberjack: Fells natural trees in their zone, including other mods' trees, and replants. Needs an axe stored in their chopping block: without one they don't chop, and the axe wears with each log. Also clears the felled tree's leaves and picks up fallen saplings and sticks, and plants the saplings where there is room. Never touches logs placed by players.
job.mca_vie.desc.fisher: Fishes from the bank in calm water in their zone.
job.mca_vie.desc.breeder: Shears sheep, breeds livestock and collects eggs in their zone.
job.mca_vie.desc.doctor: Treats sick or injured villagers in their zone. Produces nothing.
job.mca_vie.desc.blacksmith: Repairs tools, weapons and armor stored in their forge, or worn by villagers once half worn. Each repair costs the crafting material: 3 diamonds for a diamond pickaxe, 8 iron ingots for an iron chestplate, 1 netherite ingot for a netherite item. Villagers drop off their half-worn gear and come back for it once repaired.
job.mca_vie.desc.baker: Turns the wheat stored in their oven into bread: 3 wheat make 1 bread. When the oven is empty, fetches wheat from the nearest farmer's work block.
job.mca_vie.desc.teacher: Teaches the children and teens in their zone, which makes them happier. Each child taught brings them one bottle o' enchanting per day, stored in their desk.
job.mca_vie.desc.guard: MCA guard: protects the village in melee.
job.mca_vie.desc.archer: MCA archer: protects the village with a bow.
job.mca_vie.desc.miner: Digs a mine behind their cart, ore first. Put pickaxes and torches in the cart: no pickaxe, no work.
job.mca_vie.desc.cook: Cooks with what is stored in their pot: soups and stews (beetroot, mushroom, rabbit), then meat, fish and potatoes.
mca_vie.books.happiness.author: A Better MCA guide
mca_vie.books.happiness.intro:
§lHappiness§r
Every villager has a happiness from 0 to 100%.

Happy, they live longer. Unhappy, they fall ill more often.

§2Green§r: happiness goes up.
§4Red§r: it goes down.
mca_vie.books.happiness.gift.tip: Any gift the villager accepts. A refused gift gives nothing.
mca_vie.books.happiness.lesson.tip: For a child, once a day, when a teacher gives a lesson nearby.
mca_vie.books.happiness.company.tip: A friend close by, or at least 2 villagers within 16 blocks during the day.
mca_vie.books.happiness.market.tip: When the village market sold something or filled an order.
mca_vie.books.happiness.village.note: Decrees and market: every resident benefits.
mca_vie.books.happiness.hit.tip: A monster, an animal or another villager hurting them.
mca_vie.books.happiness.prison.tip: A suspect sent to prison by village justice (configurable).
mca_vie.books.happiness.lost_friend.tip: The death of a friend (relationship of 50 or more).
mca_vie.books.happiness.isolated.tip: No villager within 32 blocks all day.
mca_vie.books.happiness.enemy.tip: They live with someone they hate (relationship of −50 or less).
mca_vie.books.happiness.gifts.note: An accepted gift gives +5. Each villager has tastes based on job and personality.
mca_vie.books.happiness.cure.note: A sick villager sneezes and walks slowly. Give them the remedy like a gift.
mca_vie.books.happiness.base.intro: Happiness slowly returns to the base mood (50%). These buildings raise it:
mca_vie.books.happiness.capital.tip: When your village reaches City rank.
mca_vie.books.happiness.taxes.intro: In a village you manage, taxes change the base mood:

mca_vie.ghost.talk.0.a: Can you hear me? Where are we?
mca_vie.ghost.talk.0.b: I don't know... it's so cold.
mca_vie.ghost.talk.1.b: They can't see us anymore, I think.
mca_vie.ghost.talk.3.a: I just walked through a wall... is that normal?
mca_vie.ghost.talk.3.b: Don't look at your hands. Trust me.
mca_vie.ghost.talk.4.b: A little... there was a fire, and laughter.
mca_vie.ghost.talk.5.b: That's why we come back at night.
mca_vie.ghost.talk.7.a: I hear voices... is that you?
mca_vie.ghost.talk.7.b: No. I thought it was you.
mca_vie.ghost.talk.8.a: Is my family alright, do you think?
mca_vie.ghost.talk.8.b: They think of you. I can feel it.
mca_vie.ghost.talk.9.b: Then we'll have to leave again.

mca_vie.books.memory.author: A Better MCA guide
mca_vie.books.memory.intro:
§lThe Memorial Altar§r

A beloved villager who died can come back home at night, as a ghost.

All you need is an altar in their house and a photo of them.
mca_vie.books.memory.wall: Place it on a wall, in the villager's house
mca_vie.books.memory.take_photo: Take a picture of the villager with the phone
mca_vie.books.memory.set_portrait: In the family tree, set it as their portrait
mca_vie.books.memory.photo.note: Without a portrait, they won't show up in the list.
mca_vie.books.memory.choose.note: Only those who slept in this house.
mca_vie.books.memory.ghostly: Pale and see-through, you walk through it
mca_vie.books.tombs.author: A Better MCA guide
mca_vie.books.tombs.intro:
§lGraves§r

Every villager gets a grave.

When they die, they go to the nearest empty grave. If there is none, a grave is placed where they died.
mca_vie.books.tombs.vault.note: Each place can be reserved like a grave.
mca_vie.books.tombs.vault_name.intro:
By default, the vault reads "NAME Family", after the first villager buried.

To change it: sneak, empty hand, right-click the top plate.
